axis_choice: All seven brief axes already have (axis,value) builds in ledger/submissions.csv (47 BUILT rows, 0 receipts). The open dimension inside CONCENTRATION is prior source: built priors are parent dot density (IR-91-07, not a prior test) and the GDR thermal inventory. SLOT_PLAN.md (merged Sessions 5-7) pre-proposed GEODETIC-STRAIN CONCENTRATION as better-axis #1 with mechanism/confounder/falsifier and a 20% falsifier dose; this session builds that pre-proposed axis. MASS by the parent's own continuous ranking remains impossible (all pinned ancestors are binary; IR-91-21/consensus.py), SNAP's dose ladder is negative on its control, PRUNE radii 1-15 px are exhausted, RELIEF built 3 directed tercile arms, SPACING is the brief's lowest priority, TRACKB is built (Phase 2 only).

measured_before_build.reading: Strain is near-orthogonal to the GDR prior (new location hypothesis, same operation). Bands 4 and 7 are near-redundant and 25px vs 50px block ranks are 0.999, so NO component-only and NO block-scale arm is built: either would be the same experiment under a new id. Band 8 (dilatation) is the orthogonal tensor component, hence arm 3.

priors_frozen.strain: 0.5*pct(band4 geod_2ndinv) + 0.5*pct(band7 geod_shearrate) from pinned training_features (sha256 4371c82e...3bc5); pct = average-tie percentile rank over footprint pixels after nearest-cell (EDT) fill of nodata-Sentinel (<= -1e30) and non-finite cells inside the footprint; NaN outside footprint
priors_frozen.dilatation: pct(band8 geod_dilaterate), same fill/rank; high percentile = most positive (expansion) value; sign convention per pinned band description 'rate of volumetric strain (expansion/contraction)' - an assumption, recorded
priors_frozen.not_used: S_struct multiplier from the SLOT_PLAN falsifier sentence is NOT applied: acceptor placement already anchors 80% of moved dots on existing parent dots, and multiplying by the Session-5 composite would make the prior partly lineage-derived (IR-91-07 failure mode). Logged as IR-91-37.

builder_frozen.donor_quarantine: NEW vs the GDR build: parent dots at d_cat<=3.0px (the 2,171 inherited collar dots) may NOT be donors (IR-91-27 standard, as RELIEF/SNAP/TRACKB). The GDR builder allowed collar donors, silently mixing a partial PRUNE into CONCENTRATION. Logged as IR-91-36; implemented as an opt-in parameter defaulting to the old behaviour so GDR rebuilds stay byte-identical.

variants.hypothesis: Direct sibling of slot-1 GDR arm gdr25rm10 (same builder/settings, prior source swapped): active-strain blocks hold unmapped Quaternary splays that a springs inventory cannot see.
The SLOT_PLAN pre-proposal's own falsifier dose: moving 20% of R0 mass lowest->highest strain-tercile blocks; dose-response vs strn25m10 identifies acceptor saturation.

Extensional (areal-dilatation) component rather than shear-dominated strain magnitude locates Basin-and-Range normal-fault new geometry; near-orthogonal to bands 4/7 (Spearman 0.05-0.28), so this is a component discrimination, not a dose twin.

prediction_translator_frozen.point_MODEL: 0.2778 (R0 CLAIM, scale only) * relT * 0.5, relT = (T_cand - T_R0)/T_R0 with T from gems91.relief.fast_binary_dti on sgmc_off = SGMC & footprint & (d_cat > 3px) - the identical translator build_snap.py used (SHRINK=0.5)
prediction_translator_frozen.range_MODEL: upper = 0.2778*relT*1.0 if relT>0 else 0.2778*relT*0.25; lower = min(unshrunk SGMC point if relT<0, uniform-noise-truth delta, H19-5-lineage-mask delta), each noise/mask delta = 0.2778 * relative DTI change of candidate vs R0 on that surrogate truth (GDR-arm convention)
prediction_translator_frozen.mechanistic_sign_expectation: positive for strn arms (catalogue rate rises 0.90%->1.89% across strain-prior deciles, descriptive RECEIPT on pinned data), weaker positive for strd; if the frozen translator returns <=0 the arm is reported as predicted-negative and leaves the slot queue, exactly as SNAP was handled

slot_decision_rule_frozen: Week-1 queue (GDR slot1, PRUNE-le10 slot2) is unchanged by this session under all outcomes - two CONCENTRATION receipts in one week would spend two slots on one operation. A strain arm may replace RELIEF at slot 3 ONLY if its frozen-translator point >= +0.010 AND relT > 0; otherwise strain is a Week-2 candidate conditional on the GDR receipt.
live_evidence_rule: An absolute live change below 0.01 is no evidence on public chunks; private chunks may differ.
